scope: Exact stated six-consonant/three-vowel, 22-sign, word-preserving greedy writer on the unchanged GDT1233 panel. No word or sound values assigned, no native payload read, no computation run on native data.

key_definition.H: One of 22 signs; bare-consonant prefix, not itself a source phoneme.
key_definition.F: Six distinct non-H signs representing the Ca syllables and also serving as consonant selectors after H.
key_definition.V: Three distinct non-H signs, disjoint from F, representing isolated vowels.
key_definition.remaining: The other 12 signs represent the six Ci and six Cu syllables bijectively.

complete_fixed_key_theorem.statement: A nonempty written word is in the canonical image of the writer iff every H has a following sign in F and no within-word contiguous triple H f v occurs with f in F and v in V.
complete_fixed_key_theorem.necessity: The bare-C branch emits precisely H followed by a Ca selector. Greedy source scanning never emits bare C immediately before an isolated vowel, because that source C,V pair would have emitted a single CV sign.
complete_fixed_key_theorem.sufficiency: Parse H+F as a bare-C token and every other sign as one V or CV token. H cannot be in F, so parsing is forced. Every bare-C token is followed either by word end or a token starting with C; otherwise the forbidden triple occurs. Every singleton CV token already contains exactly the greedy C,V pair. Isolated V tokens start with a vowel and are written singly. Thus re-encoding the decoded source reproduces each token and the entire word exactly. No longer-range condition or phoneme-label equality is needed.
complete_fixed_key_theorem.boundary_detail: Forbidden triples are tested within each complete group only. An H,F code at word end followed by a vowel at the next word is legal. H may never be consumed as a selector since H is disjoint from F.
complete_fixed_key_theorem.language_detail: Sufficiency concerns arbitrary strings over the specified nine abstract phonemes, not membership in any historical language or source vocabulary.

head_exhaustion.statement: On the full unchanged 1233 panel the only possible H values are cfh and cph, separately in each reading.
proof: The 21 singleton codes plus six H,F codes form a prefix-free codebook. Every native word must belong to its free concatenation language, even though canonical source packing restricts which concatenations the writer emits. Hence the GDT1234 necessary quotient obligations apply.
Nineteen fixed units are forced singleton code entries, so none can be H. The only remaining candidates are cfh, cph and q. All units occur, so H cannot be inactive.

The q head requires 11 or 12 distinct followers under the original quotient obligations, exceeding six. Each cfh/cph head requires six distinct second signs. There are exactly six selector slots, so their sets are forced, not subsets to be optimized.
GDT1248 constructs and verifies exact two-sign codes for precisely those sets over the complete panel. This establishes ordinary parsing, not the new canonicality condition.
head_exhaustion.limits: This exhaustiveness inherits all original exact unit, whole-group and rare-form assumptions. It is not exhaustive after changing eligibility, allowing errors, or changing physical units.

definitions: For a candidate H and its forced F, let R=S minus ({H} union F), of size 15.
T_H is the set of signs occupying the position immediately after an H,F code inside any retained word; no symbol is added at end of word.
complete_unknown_key_reduction.all_structural_keys: Exactly all three-element subsets V of U_H. A head has any canonical key iff |U_H| >= 3. The number of structural role assignments is binomial(|U_H|,3), at most 455 for each head, at most 910 total per reading.
complete_unknown_key_reduction.all_sound_keys: For each surviving H,F,V assignment there are 6! times 3! times 12! label bijections: assign six Ca signs to consonants, assign isolated signs to the three vowels, and assign the remaining signs to the twelve Ci/Cu pairs. Every such bijection has identical native canonicality status. This is a key-count factor, not recovered phonemes or independent evidence.
complete_unknown_key_reduction.no_missing_constraint: Any additional restriction involving which Ca sign belongs to which consonant, which isolated sign is Va, or which remaining sign is Ci/Cu must come from a source/phonology contract, not this source-free canonicality test.

smallest_exhaustive_algorithm: Bind the unchanged1233/1248 sources and exact 22-unit tokenization. Keep each reading separate.

Traverse every complete unit sequence once per candidate head. Check ordinary parsing and collect one source-bound triple witness for each sign in T_H intersect R; optionally count all occurrences and leaves without treating them as independent confirmations.
Compute U_H by bitset subtraction. No permutation solver, phonetic search, source corpus or key optimizer is needed.
Enumerate the at most455 triples V from U_H to publish the complete survivor list, or represent it exactly as all size-three subsets with its binomial cardinality.

A failed head needs at least13 distinct R signs excluded by actual triples, leaving at most2. An exclusion certificate can retain one exact complete-group witness for each of those13 signs. Preserve all source identities and boundaries.

Independently replay the source words with a token-state machine and compare every role-mask decision. For selected formal representatives, explicit decode then greedy re-encode supplies an additional implementation check; this does not assign supported sounds.
complexity: O(total retained units) collection plus at most910 role masks per reading, or only bitsets when explicit key listing is unnecessary. The inherited head/follower proof obviates scanning22! keys.

additional_source_free_obligations.per_word_counts: For a written word of n working units, b occurrences of H, and v occurrences of isolated-V signs outside H,F pairs: decoded vowel phonemes = n-2b; decoded consonant phonemes = n-b-v; decoded total phonemes = 2n-3b-v. F and V are disjoint, so no isolated-V sign is hidden inside a bare pair.
additional_source_free_obligations.bare_consonant_equivalence: A decoded source word contains any consonant cluster or final consonant iff its writing contains H. This uses the exact greedy source contract, not a language generalization.
additional_source_free_obligations.frequency: The deterministic writer is injective on full phoneme words, so exact word equality/frequency is preserved. Sign keys cannot repair an incompatible fixed source word-frequency distribution.

code_audit.within_declared_domain: The existing encode, decode and direct_legal functions implement the stated fixed symbolic inventory and token canonicality. No within-contract discrepancy found by inspection.
code_audit.control_ceiling: The saved controls test phoneme words only up to length4 and written sequences only up to length3. Those finite tests alone are not an arbitrary-length proof; the token argument above supplies that proof.
code_audit.domain_note: direct_legal assumes its inputs belong to S; it does not itself reject arbitrary unknown non-H strings. Its existing exhaustive output loop supplies only S, so this is not a demonstrated control failure. Any new parser must enforce the22-unit input domain.
code_audit.execution: No existing source-free control or native calculation was rerun in this audit.

decision_note: The proposal’s claim that no source-free native test is useful solely because source language is unbound is too restrictive. Failure would close this exact writer for every sign key; survival would establish only formal canonical compatibility and quantify a remaining key class. These are distinct structural decisions even though neither supplies a translated word. A compact conditional test is possible without lexical guesses; source matching should remain a separate later question.
retained_predecessors: GDT1234/1248 original outcomes and the failures of fixed source writers remain unchanged. Followup cards were checked; broader free-UD countercodes and different gap or carrier tests do not replace this prefix-free CV contract.
publication_limit: Root owns scientific selection, native execution, any registry update and publication. This artifact records proof and audit only.
